oak.tech_tree

Technology Tree management for Crafter achievements.

This module provides the TechnologyTree class that manages the directed acyclic graph (DAG) of achievement dependencies, enabling queries for available subtasks and prerequisite checking.

Classes

TechnologyTree([dag_path])

Manages the technology tree (DAG) of Crafter achievements.
class oak.tech_tree.TechnologyTree(dag_path: Path | None = None)[source]

Bases: object

Manages the technology tree (DAG) of Crafter achievements.

The technology tree defines which achievements depend on others, enabling the agent to determine which subtasks are currently available based on completed prerequisites.

prerequisites

Dict mapping each achievement to its required prerequisites.

dependents

Dict mapping each achievement to achievements that depend on it.

root_achievements

Set of achievements with no prerequisites.

Check if all prerequisites for an achievement are completed.

get_available_subtasks(completed: Set[str], exclude_completed: bool = True) → List[str][source]

Get subtasks that are currently available to pursue.

An achievement is available if: 1. All its prerequisites are completed 2. It has not been completed yet (if exclude_completed=True)

Parameters:

  • completed – Set of completed achievement names.

  • exclude_completed – Whether to exclude already completed achievements.

Returns:

List of available achievement names, ordered by topological sort.

get_next_subtasks(completed: Set[str]) → List[str][source]

Get the next recommended subtasks based on tech tree progression.

Prioritizes achievements that unlock the most dependents.

Parameters:

completed – Set of completed achievement names.

Returns:

List of recommended next achievements, sorted by priority.

topological_order() → List[str][source]

Get achievements in topological order (prerequisites before dependents).

Returns:

List of achievement names in topological order.

get_depth(achievement: str) → int[source]

Get the depth of an achievement in the technology tree.

Depth is the length of the longest path from any root to this achievement.

Parameters:

achievement – Name of the achievement.

Returns:

Depth in the tree (0 for root achievements).

Get the critical (longest) path to an achievement.

Parameters:

achievement – Target achievement name.

Returns:
